subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's in these food-product reviews and what's worth attention or actionable.

judge.implied_focus: Identifying actionable, attention-worthy signals in food-product reviews — i.e. what customers care about (issues) and how much a review matters/warrants attention

per_column.name: sentiment_label
per_column.rationale: Polarity is a core facet of what's worth attention (negative reviews flag problems); directly relevant to actionability.

per_column.name: helpfulness_ratio
per_column.rationale: Proxy for how much a review matters to other users — a legitimate attention/prioritisation facet.

per_column.name: review_length_bucket
per_column.rationale: Bucketed text length is a generic surface metric, not a substantive attention/issue facet.

per_column.name: issue_flags
per_column.rationale: Multi-label extraction of concrete concerns (taste, shipping, quality, value, health) is the strongest actionable facet — directly names what's worth attention.

per_column.name: repeat_buy_signal
per_column.rationale: Repeat-purchase intent is a meaningful, actionable outcome signal tied to product quality.

per_column.name: exclamation_count
per_column.rationale: Raw punctuation count is a mechanical surface metric; only weak, undifferentiated proxy for intensity.

per_column.name: caps_ratio
per_column.rationale: Capitalisation ratio is a generic stylistic/noise metric, not a substantive facet of what's actionable.

judge.rationale: A coherent actionability-focused core exists: issue_flags, sentiment_label, repeat_buy_signal, and helpfulness_ratio collectively centre on 'what's worth attention/action in reviews' — issue_flags in particular is a rich, well-structured, directly actionable decomposition of customer concerns. However coherence and structure are diluted by three mechanical surface metrics (review_length_bucket, exclamation_count, caps_ratio) that add generic text-statistics noise rather than facets of the implied focus, pulling the set partway toward a grab-bag. The implied focus is genuinely actionable (an analyst can triage by issue type, sentiment, and helpfulness), so actionability scores high, but the mix of substantive and mechanical columns caps focus_coherence and structure_quality in the middle range.
